description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Archfiend of the Dross and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
The Archfiend of the Dross tokens enter the battlefield with zero oil counters due to Solemnity.
At the beginning of each oppponent's next upkeep, their Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing them to lose the game.
